author: Anas
title: Hiring artist for ongoing comics
content: Looking for an artist for ongoing comic work. Style: simple, bold-outline cartoon style (doesn't need to be super detailed/polished). Work: I write the script, you draw a short comic based on it. Volume: starting with 5 comics so there's a decent amount of work to go around. Pay: budget-friendly rate, paid per comic, open to your quote. DM me your rate + a few style samples if you're interested. Long-term work if it's a good fit. Contact: DM @nas2litt
